name: jig-review
description: Configurable parallel reviews with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor/Grok.

interface.shortDescription: Configurable Claude, Codex, and Grok reviews
interface.longDescription: Codex skill for selecting isolated Claude Code, native Codex, and Cursor Agent with Grok 4.6 review subagents, running them in parallel over the same scope, then deduplicating and merging their findings. Includes bundled read-only adapters for the external CLIs; Claude plus Codex remains the default pair.
defaultPrompt: Review my changes with Claude and Codex
